provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10 (docs.cloud.google.com, where cloud.google.com/translate/docs now redirects). Limits: besides the request quotas declared, 6,000,000 characters a minute per project to the general model (v2 and v3 together; 100,000 to a custom model), 2,400 document pages a minute, 30,000 code points a request (v3); a quota exceeded answers 403 (User Rate Limit Exceeded), not 429. Attribution: required - the 'powered by Google Translate' graphic adjacent to every translation, linked to http://translate.google.com; a page that can be indexed marks machine-translated text as such; the product's name may not hold Google's brands. Data retention: content held briefly in memory to translate it, used for nothing but the service, never to train Google's translation; glossaries stored, encrypted, on Google Cloud. Keys: v3 takes no API key, only OAuth 2.0 tokens (a service account or Application Default Credentials). Pricing and its free tier: the pricing page could not be read on 2026-11-10, so no figure is declared. Commercial use: a Google Cloud service under its terms; caching and storage of translations: the pages read say nothing, hence unknown.
